carries: SCANNER — why products that once scanned stopped scanning. Three causes, all on the server, none in the app: (1) an unknown product cost five or six lookups — every form of the code, then three sibling databases that hold nothing a child eats — against a budget of twelve a minute shared by every parent, so two unknowns in a row and the next real product came back 'busy'; food only now, one call per form; (2) the product cache lived on Render's disk, which is wiped on every deploy, so every push forgot every product; a seed now ships in the repository, data/products-seen.json, loaded under the live cache and never expiring; (3) the disk cache was written every twenty scans — a server that saw nineteen never wrote; it writes within five seconds of a change

the cycle folds the products the live server found into the seed, through a route keyed on BOUCHEES_ADMIN_SECRET; proven on an instance: Render redeployed, disk empty, Open Food Facts offline — a seeded product answers in zero calls
no build: the app is unchanged
